texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.MinAmoun: Withdrawal requests below this gross amount are rejected.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.FeeRate: Decimal fraction of the gross amount; fee truncated to 8 decimals.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.MaxDaily: Reject any single order above this amount (online MaxDailyWithdraw semantics); 0 or empty = unlimited.
Max valid withdrawals per UTC day.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.AutoAppr: Pending orders with gross amount <= this are auto-approved by the worker.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.Halt: true = reject submissions and block all approvals.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.Broadcas: Broadcasting orders older than this enter stuck-recovery.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.MaxRetri: Beyond this RetryCount the order fails terminally.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.HotWalle: Approvals are blocked when hot-wallet USDT falls below this floor.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.MinHotWa: Approvals are refused when hot-wallet BNB is below this.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.Enabled: false = reject submissions and the broadcast worker sleeps; hot-changeable on the settings page.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.Broadcas: Broadcast worker round interval; minimum 5 seconds.
Max withdrawal orders processed per broadcast round.
texts.Description:Collection.Withdraw.AutoAppr: Max withdrawal orders auto-approved per round.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.ScanEnabled: Scan worker scans blocks and creates deposit orders when on; sleeps when off. Hot-changeable.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.SweepEnable: Sweep worker fuels/consolidates/credits when on; sleeps when off.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.HotWalletWa: Periodically scans hot-wallet token transfers and reconciles them against withdrawals; unmatched outflows raise anomalies.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.ScanInterva: Scan worker round interval; minimum 5 seconds.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.SweepInterv: Sweep worker round interval; minimum 5 seconds.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.HotWalletWa: Hot-wallet watch round interval; minimum 5 seconds.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.ScanBehindB: Alert when the cursor falls this far behind chain head.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.SweepRoundL: Max amount activated per token per round; empty or 0 = unlimited.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.SweepTaskBa: Maximum tasks checked per processing stage, per token and round (1–100, default 20).
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.FuelBnbLimi: Max BNB per fueling transfer; beyond this the task fails for manual handling.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.GasBnbAlert: Alert when the gas address BNB falls below this.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.RetryCooldo: Retryable failures are re-queued after this cooldown.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.Rebroadcast: Sweep broadcasts without a receipt may be re-signed after this grace.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.SweepStuckM: Alert when a sweep stays in Sweeping beyond this duration.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.SkipRatioWi: Window for computing the skipped-deposit ratio.
texts.Description:Collection.Chain.SkipRatioTh: Alert when skipped+overflowed share exceeds this ratio (0-1).
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:DepositNotReleasable: Deposit order is not releasable (must be Confirmed with no sweep task).
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:SweepTaskNotRetryabl: Sweep task is not retryable (only Failed tasks can be retried).
texts.AbpAdmin.Collection:HotWalletTxnNotAckab: Hot wallet transaction is not ackable (only Anomaly rows can be acknowledged).
